content.value_statement: Public apps need a clear way to control feature access. This skill adds request, approval, rejection, and admin review flows.
actual_capabilities: Defines Motoko approval status types and approval state functions.
Adds backend methods for approval checks, requests, admin decisions, and listing users.
Shows how admins bypass approval checks through authorization permissions.
Describes frontend states for pending users, approved users, and admins.
Outlines an admin dashboard for reviewing and changing approval status.
limitations: Requires the authorization extension to be installed first.
Does not provide a complete frontend implementation.
Does not define persistence details beyond the prefabricated module.
Requires developers to place approval checks on protected functions.

use_cases.title: Gate Beta Access
use_cases.description: Product teams can let users request access before enabling core features.

use_cases.title: Review Community Signups
use_cases.description: Community app builders can collect approval requests and let admins approve trusted members.

use_cases.title: Add Admin Approval Controls
use_cases.description: Developers can add backend methods and dashboard actions for user review workflows.

prompt_templates.title: Add Basic Approval
prompt_templates.prompt: Add user approval to my Caffeine AI app. Use this skill and explain the backend methods I need.

prompt_templates.title: Implement Backend Methods
prompt_templates.prompt: Update my Motoko backend with approval state, request approval, caller status checks, approval listing, and admin approval updates.

prompt_templates.title: Build Approval UI
prompt_templates.prompt: Create the frontend approval flow for pending, rejected, approved, and admin users. Include admin dashboard actions.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Protected Functions
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my app for missing approval checks on public functions. Identify protected features and recommend exact guard placement.

output_examples.input: I need to restrict access until an admin approves a user.
output_examples.output: Backend approval checks and request methods are added. The frontend shows request access and blocks protected features until approval.

output_examples.input: An admin needs to review pending users.
output_examples.output: The app lists approval statuses and lets admins approve or reject users from a dashboard.
Admins stay approved automatically. Non-admin users must request approval before using protected features.

best_practices: Install and apply the authorization extension before adding approval logic.
Guard every protected backend function, not only the frontend route.
Show clear pending, approved, and rejected states in the UI.
anti_patterns: Do not rely on hidden buttons as the only access control.
Do not let non-admin callers list or change approval records.
Do not approve all new users by default unless the app is public.

faq.question: Does this skill replace authorization?
faq.answer: No. It depends on authorization and adds approval status checks on top.

faq.question: Can admins access protected features?
faq.answer: Yes. The guide states existing admins are automatically approved.

faq.question: Does it include frontend code?
faq.answer: It describes expected frontend flows, but it does not ship a complete UI.

faq.question: Which backend methods are covered?
faq.answer: It covers status checks, approval requests, approval listing, and admin approval updates.

faq.question: Who can approve users?
faq.answer: Only callers with admin permission should approve, reject, or list users.

faq.question: Is this specific to Caffeine AI?
faq.answer: Yes. The instructions target Caffeine AI skills and Motoko backend integration.
